Bundesliga, the second tier of the German football league system.](#ref-1) Founded on 23 September 1903 as the football department of the gymnastics club Turnverein 1860 Fürth, it became an independent entity known as SpVgg Fürth before merging with TSV Vestenbergsgreuth in 1996, adopting the "Greuther" prefix to honor the nearby village.](#ref-2)](#ref-3) The club, nicknamed *Die Kleeblätter* (The Cloverleaves) after the green clover emblem on its badge, plays its home matches at the Sportpark Ronhof | Thomas Sommer, which has a capacity of 16,626 spectators.](#ref-3)](#ref-4) The club's most successful period occurred in the pre-Bundesliga era during the 1910s and 1920s, when it captured three German championships in 1914, 1926, and 1929, establishing itself as one of the dominant forces in early German football.](#ref-5)](#ref-6) Additional honors include one 2.
